channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Oregon Media Arts Fellowship 2026 (two USD 5,000 awards for Oregon media artists)
item.description: Portland Art Museum (PAM CUT) and Oregon Arts Commission · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · Two fellowships of USD 5,000 each, no matching funds required; paid within two months of notification. No application fee.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council New York Fellowship 2027 (USD 38,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · USD 38,000 for the six-month fellowship, covering the immersive cultural exchange in New York City. No application fee.

item.title: Asian Cultural Council Individual Fellowship 2027 (up to USD 35,000)
item.description: Asian Cultural Council · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 35,000 for self-directed exploration and cultural exchange of 1 to 6 months. Single or joint applications (up to 3 participants). No application fee.

item.title: Screen Australia Global Fellowships (AUD 80,000-100,000)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline 11 Feb 2027 · Non-recoupable grants of AUD 80,000 (single continuous placement of up to 6 months) or AUD 100,000 (multiple placements over up to 12 months), plus up to AUD 5,000 for carers' and/or accessibility costs. Up to 10 fellows annually.

item.title: The Center Fellowship for Justice-Impacted Artists (Center for Art & Advocacy, US)
item.description: The Center for Art & Advocacy · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · USD 10,000 in unrestricted funds plus USD 10,000 in project development funds per fellow, awarded annually.

item.title: Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans 2027 (US graduate study)
item.description: The Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · Up to USD 90,000 over two years (stipend and tuition support) toward graduate study; 30 fellowships awarded annually. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Fellowship for Utopian Practice 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, feedback and mentoring. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Black Utopian Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Disability Arts + Dreaming Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, a Thought Partner, mentors in the field, and access check-ins, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Climate Justice Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: American Academy in Rome: Rome Prize Fellowship 2027-28
item.description: American Academy in Rome · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Stipends of USD 16,000 (half-term, about 5 months) and USD 30,000 (full-term, about 10 months), plus housing, workspace and weekday meals. Approximately 30 fellowships per year. APPLICATION FEE: USD 50 by 1 November (USD 60 for multiple categories); USD 80/90 in the late window to 15 November.

item.title: Wave Farm: 2027 Research and Production Program (Transmission Art Residencies and Radio Art Fellowships, NY)
item.description: Wave Farm · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · USD 1,000 stipend for each 10-day residency; USD 2,000 for each two-month Radio Art Fellowship. No application fee.

item.title: Rhizome x Hartwig Art Foundation: Amsterdam City Fellow (two-year digital art research fellowship)
item.description: Rhizome, in partnership with Hartwig Art Foundation · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,200 per month stipend for a part-time commitment of roughly 2 days per week, over a two-year term (about EUR 28,800 total). Tickets to the Extreme Presence gathering provided. No application fee indicated.

item.title: Harry Ransom Center Research Fellowships 2027-2028 (Austin, Texas)
item.description: Harry Ransom Center, The University of Texas at Austin · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · Postdoctoral Fellowships: USD 3,500 per month for one or two months. Dissertation Fellowships: USD 2,500. Travel Stipends: USD 2,000 (open to graduate students, faculty and independent researchers including artists and journalists). International recipients get an extra USD 500. No application fee.

item.title: AAPI Fund: Creative Catalyst Fellowship 2027 (theme Belonging)
item.description: AAPI Civic Engagement Fund · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to eight artists each receive USD 30,000 to produce new work. Also covered: the two-day Fellows retreat (travel and accommodation paid by the AAPI Fund), an accomplished communications consultant, digital advertising, community introductions, exhibition placement support and replica development (posters, books, calendars) promoting the finished work. No application fee.

item.title: A.I.R. Gallery: Fellowship Program 2027-2028 (NYC)
item.description: A.I.R. Gallery · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · USD 3,000 stipend per fellow, plus a solo exhibition at A.I.R. Gallery, 4 to 5 professional development workshops, an assigned artist-mentor, a studio visit with a review panelist and ongoing staff support. Six fellows selected. No application fee stated.

item.title: Braunschweig Projects 2027/28: Artistic Fellowships at HBK Braunschweig (Fine Arts and Sound Art)
item.description: Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig), on behalf of the State of Lower Saxony · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for 12 months, plus a rent-free one-person studio apartment in Braunschweig (fellows pay EUR 250 per month towards incidental living costs) and an allowance for project and travel costs. 7 fellowships: 5 in fine arts and 2 in sound art. No application fee.

item.title: American-Scandinavian Foundation: Fellowships for Americans in the Nordic Countries 2027-28
item.description: American-Scandinavian Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Long-term fellowships of up to USD 23,000 for 4 to 12 months; short-term grants of up to USD 5,000 for 1 to 3 months. In 2026, 31 American Fellows received over USD 277,390 in total funding. Awards are given in all fields, including creative arts projects.

item.title: 5 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowships - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• BAVC MediaMaker Fellowship 2027
    https://bavc.org/programs/mediamaker/
    BAVC Media (Bay Area Video Coalition) · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · USD 10,000 distributed to each Fellow over the course of the fellowship, plus travel per diems. Non-cash support includes flights and accommodation for two San Francisco convenings, festival and conference access with travel covered, professional mentorship and strategy sessions, five hours of one-to-one mentorship through MediaMaker Connect, and ongoing workshops. Bay Area fellows also get access to BAVC's co-working space and facilities. No application fee.
  • True Blue Fellowship 2027
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/
    Bow Seat Ocean Awareness Programs · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · Up to USD 2,500 in project funding per fellow, plus mentorship and capacity-building programming. Twelve youth are selected annually. No application fee.
  • The Impart & Nalli Fellowships 2027-28
    https://imp-art.org/fellowship-grant/impart-x-nalli-fellowships/
    Impart in collaboration with Nalli Silks · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Up to INR 5.5 lakhs (INR 550,000) per fellow towards project execution, covering research-related expenses including travel, fieldwork and documentation subject to approval. Two fellowships are awarded. No application fee.
  • Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Travel Fellowship 2026
    https://www.lasellefoundation.org/travel-fellowship
    Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Foundation · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Two awards of USD 5,000 each, distributed in the fall of 2026, to fund a research trip that furthers the artist's practice. No application fee.
  • This is Gender Regional Curatorial Fellowship 2026
    https://thisisgender.global5050.org/regional-curatorial-fellowship/
    This is Gender (Global 50/50) · deadline 22 Sep 2026 · Stipend of up to GBP 3,000 for the seven-month part-time fellowship. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Princeton Arts Fellowship 2027-2029 (Lewis Center for the Arts)
    https://apply.interfolio.com/187043
    Princeton University, Lewis Center for the Arts · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · USD 93,000 salary per year for each of two academic years, as a full-time 24-month appointment at the rank of Associate Professional Specialist. No application fee.

item.title: 3 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowships - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• AI Builders Fellowship 2026 (Internet Archive Canada x BC + AI)
    https://bc-ai.ca/fellowship
    Internet Archive Canada (IAC) in partnership with BC + AI · deadline 21 Aug 2026 · $5,000 award for one selected builder. No application fee.
  • Helpmann Fellowships 2026
    https://helpmannacademy.com.au/helpmann-fellowships/
    Helpmann Academy · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Up to AUD 7,500 per fellowship, three fellowships available. Supported by the James & Diana Ramsay Foundation. No application fee.
  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    https://jobs.arts.ac.uk/job/12629-storytelling-research-fellows/
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowships - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Instituto Sacatar: Sacatar Fellowship 2027 (Bahia, Brazil)
    https://sacatar.org/en/fellowships/
    Instituto Sacatar · deadline 28 Aug 2026 · Fully hosted residency: private bedroom with attached bathroom, three meals a day (except Saturday evenings, Sundays and Brazilian holidays), an individual studio suited to the discipline, weekly laundry, logistical support and airport transfer from Salvador. NO STIPEND, no airfare and no materials budget. USD 25 application fee. One French artist may additionally receive airfare and a stipend through Villa Fatumbi.
  • Columbia Institute for Ideas and Imagination: Paris Fellowship 2027-28
    https://ideasimagination.columbia.edu/apply/applying-for-a-fellowship/
    Columbia University Institute for Ideas and Imagination · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 75,000 stipend, plus housing at Reid Hall in Paris and office and research support, September 2027 to May 2028. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowships - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Stiftung Künstler*dorf Schöppingen: Residency Fellowship 2027 Open Call
    https://stiftung-kuenstlerdorf.de/en/application_process
    Stiftung Künstler*dorf Schöppingen · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,500 per month, minus roughly EUR 100-200 for rent and operating expenses. For collectives, EUR 1,000 per person up to a maximum of EUR 3,000 per month, minus rent and operating costs. Travel, insurance and material costs are covered only in exceptional cases, on request.
  • The Hodder Fellowship 2027-2028 (Princeton University)
    https://arts.princeton.edu/fellowships/hodder-fellowship/
    Princeton University, Lewis Center for the Arts · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · USD 93,000 stipend for the 10-month appointment as a Visiting Fellow. No formal teaching is involved. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Adrianna Newell Fellowship at Arts&Rec 2026
    https://www.nyfa.org/opportunities/opportunity-info/?title=call-for-applications%3A-the-adrianna-newell-fellowship-at-arts%26rec%2C-october-2026&id=013e03ad-6edf-47fb-8d14-291bdc930a31
    Arts&Rec Inc · deadline 31 Jul 2026 · Live/work residency: use of a 1000 sq ft studio and attached apartment, plus a $1,500 total materials stipend and per diem. Travel (especially international) is not funded. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Wave Hill / AnkhLave Arts Alliance: 2027 Van Lier Fellowship (NYC)
    https://wavehill.slideroom.com/#/login/program/89300
    Wave Hill / AnkhLave Arts Alliance · deadline 10 Aug 2026 · $10,435 stipend, including an $8,000 honorarium, a transportation stipend for the residency, and professional development opportunities, plus the Winter Workspace residency, a solo exhibition with public programs, mentorship from Wave Hill curatorial staff and arts professionals, and AnkhLave Alumni Network benefits. Two fellowships awarded. No application fee.

item.title: 3 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowships - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Ucross Fellowship for Native American Visual Artists: Spring 2027
    https://www.ucrossfoundation.org/residency-program.html
    Ucross Foundation · deadline 15 Jul 2026 · Fully funded fellowship residency; living accommodations, meals, and work space provided. No application fee.
  • Mountainfilm: Commitment Grants & Emerging Filmmaker Fellowship
    https://www.mountainfilm.org/mountainfilm-initiatives/commitment-grants/
    Mountainfilm · deadline 16 Jul 2026 · Over USD 90,000 in total funding. Individual Commitment Grants range from USD 3,000 to 6,000. The Emerging Filmmaker Fellowship adds a yearlong mentorship, a cash award, and a funded trip to Telluride over Memorial Day weekend (travel, lodging, and a festival pass).
  • Target Margin Theater: TMT Institute Fellowship 2026-27
    https://www.targetmargin.org/institute/
    Target Margin Theater · deadline 22 Jul 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend, plus space, material resources, and collaborators to support each Fellow's experiments. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 22 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Artivism & Amplifiers Fellowship 2026
    https://www.humanimpactsinstitute.org/opportunities
    Human Impacts Institute · deadline 01 Jul 2026 · USD 1,000 stipend upon completion. Supported by expert workshops and creative mentors.
